Title: Compare Clusterings for Single-Cell Sequencing
Description:
Provides functionality for running and comparing many
different clusterings of single-cell sequencing data or other
large mRNA Expression data sets.

_commit.author: Elizabeth Purdom <epurdom@stat.berkeley.edu>
_commit.message:
Stop importing NMF so loading the namespace does not change search path

NMF's .onLoad attaches Biobase (and thereby BiocGenerics and generics).
Because NAMESPACE had importFrom(NMF, aheatmap), loading clusterExperiment
changed the search path, which R CMD check reports as a WARNING for
data("rsecFluidigm") (the stored object references the clusterExperiment
namespace). All NMF calls already use NMF::, so drop the import.

This exposed base-R and Biobase functions that were used without being
imported (they resolved only via NMF's side effect). Import them explicitly
in the new R/imports.R and add utils and Biobase to Imports.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
